title: Schwalbe Motion Spike studded winter tire
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Schwalbe presents the Motion Spike as an entry-level studded winter tire (up to 120 spikes on 28-inch sizes) for occasional commuting or touring in moderate winter conditions, and recommends the Marathon Plus Spike for regular riding on icy streets. It tells riders to break in studded tires for around 40 km on the road, avoiding abrupt braking or powerful acceleration, so the spikes seat securely. No compatibility with any particular bike is implied.
